notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
description:
Activate Tranquil Thicket's cycling ability by paying {G} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Tranquil Thicket ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Tranquil Thicket and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
